shapeSummary: Green PCB 36.07 x 27.94 x 1.6 mm (bottom at Y=0, thickness along Y) with two 2.18 mm through mounting holes, a simplified mini-USB connector box on the -X edge, and two 3x6 0.1 in male header blocks with square pins along the long edges.
warnings: PCB thickness 1.6 mm is assumed; no height was given.
Mounting hole positions are estimated and approximate.
Header block layout, pin lengths, USB connector size and position are approximated from the photo.
The microcontroller, LEDs, jumper, SMD components and other small parts are omitted.
Orientation assumed: USB toward -X, long axis along X, Y up.
cadquery:
bw, bl, t = 27.94, 36.07, 1.6
part = cq.Workplane('XY').box(bl, t, bw, centered=(True, False, True))
# mounting holes (approximate positions), axis along Y
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(15, 0.1), (-15.5, 8.2)]).circle(1.09).extrude(-5)
part = part.cut(holes)
# mini-USB connector on -X edge
usb = cq.Workplane('XY').box(9, 3.9, 7.7, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-14, t, 0))
part = part.union(usb)
# two 3x6 male header blocks along the long edges
pins = []
for zc in (-8.66, 8.66):
    base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(15.24, 2.54, 7.62, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((3, t, zc))
    part = part.union(base)
    for i in range(6):
        for j in range(3):
            pins.append((3 + (i - 2.5) * 2.54, zc + (j - 1) * 2.54))
pinsol = cq.Workplane('XZ').workplane(offset=3).pushPoints(pins).rect(0.64, 0.64).extrude(-13.1)
part = part.union(pinsol)
